description: If you're looking for an exhilarating experience in the sunny paradise of Goa, look no further than Splash Down Waterpark. This cool water park located in Anjuna, North Goa, promises a day filled with thrilling rides, laughter, and memories to cherish for a lifetime. With its variety of pools, slides, and other exciting features, Splash Down is a haven for adventure seekers and families alike. Let's dive into the splashing adventure that awaits you at Goa's coolest water park. A Wonderland of Fun and Freedom: Splash Down Waterpark is not just a place for water slides; it's a world of invigorating exuberance. From the moment you step inside, you'll rediscover the child within you as you hurtle down the slides and bask in the carefree atmosphere. Whether you're a mild thrill-seeker or a brave heart, there's something for everyone here. The park offers a perfect blend of adventure, fun, and freedom, where age and worries fade away, leaving you with unforgettable memories. Timings and Tickets: The waterpark welcomes visitors all year round, from 10:30 am to 6:00 pm, ensuring you can plan your splash-filled day anytime you desire. To enter the park, visitors need to purchase admission tickets, which cover access to all rides except food and drinks. Additional charges may apply for locker rental, swimwear, towels, sunbeds, and the new ride called Gliderman. The admission fees are categorized based on height and time of entry: 1. Junior (height below 4 ft.) - ₹420 INR 2. General (height above 4 ft.) - ₹520 INR 3. Senior (with a senior card) - ₹420 INR 4. Spectator (not allowed into the pool) - ₹350 INR Prices decrease after 4:30 pm: 1. Junior - ₹370 INR 2. General - ₹440 INR 3. Senior - ₹370 INR 4. Spectator - ₹310 INR Amusement Park Rides and Attractions: Splash Down Waterpark boasts an array of exciting rides catering to visitors of all ages. Whether you're a thrill-seeker or prefer a leisurely ride with family, there's an attraction for everyone. Some of the must-try rides include: 1. Awesome Threesome: Experience a 30 ft. aggressive slide perfect for racing with two friends. 2. Zoom Fume: Enjoy a 350 ft. winding tube with whipping turns, alone or with a partner. 3. Twister: Embrace the chills of twists and turns on this thrilling ride. 4. Tornado: Get flushed into the pool from a 30 ft. tube, creating a whirlwind of excitement. 5. Boomerang: Oscillate back and forth on an inflatable raft, adding an extra element of fun. 6. Family Flume: Take a ride to the pool with your loved ones and make cherished memories together. 7. Aqua Dance: Dance in the rains to catchy tracks and let the rhythm elevate your spirits. 8. Gliderman (Extra Charge): Swim and fly simultaneously in this new addition to the rides. Splash Down Waterpark in Goa is a haven of adventure, fun, and laughter, providing a delightful experience for all ages. With its exciting array of slides and attractions, this water park promises to create cherished memories for families, friends, and thrill-seekers alike. So, gather your loved ones and head to Splash Down Waterpark for a splashing adventure that will leave you with lasting smiles and an indelible sense of joy.

headers.content:
Follow Park Rules: Observe and follow all the rules and regulations of the waterpark to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone.
Height Restrictions: Be aware of height restrictions for certain rides and slides. Some attractions may have height limitations for safety reasons.
Water Safety: While at the waterpark, prioritize water safety. Non-swimmers and young children should always be supervised by a responsible adult.
Food and Beverages: Many waterparks have designated areas for food and drinks. Check the park's policy on bringing outside food.
Locker Rentals: Consider renting a locker to secure your belongings while enjoying the waterpark's attractions.
